title: Conditional κ = 0.001469603966017302: rank-sector102 on112 ports, fully rebuilt
body:
Composes #522's coordinate-total rank sector, #525's 102-pivot selection and #523's deletion of eight isolated ports. The resulting conditional **κ = 0.001469603966017302**, exactly `734801983008651/500000000000000000`, is about **0.158% above #527** at `2080903b9e6bd01e3f64cc4c7c62ea1b3af0aa6a`. The complex endpoint is `0.001471766880461882016830`; the freshly reconstructed #493 bit operator remains nonbinding.

Every one of the 40,320 helper roles has a literal whole physical owner. Final stock is 7,168 live and 7,738 physical streams, with 560 helpers and deficit 2,560. Both suppliers are reconstructed from source; no cached supplier output or optimizer is used in verification.

The changed 120-port word passes all-column scalar replay, all 102 omitted-correction controls, phases, wrappers, common labels and guarded physical checks. A new independent audit proves the expanded 112-port program is exactly a disjoint projection of that guarded program: retained instructions, frames and coefficients match under register renaming, and no retained operation reads a deleted register. All three projection mutants fail. The restriction saves eight rank-one and sixteen rank-eight children.

Fresh 112-port phases, global data restriction, actual orthogonal charts, whole-owner windows, independent raw reconstruction and the complete finite invoice pass. The raw auditor reads no nominated profile or windows. Local forward/backward prefixes use 20/25 bits; the global bound is 210 under the charged 512. Both exact rational moment engines, six bootstrap levels, 47 strict outer inequalities and four outer controls pass.

Validation: full cold macOS and Linux Python 3.14 replays pass all **18 root stages, 21 supplier stages and 13 changed local stages**, with byte-identical complete results. The validation directory binds both runs to the frozen manifest and preserves the initial fixture/launcher failures and their corrections. All 346 pinned upstream files were compared with their exact Git objects. GitHub CI is separate.

This is a finite conditional witness. All-size compiler, common-label/mutable-basis realization, normalized Lemma A, restored-row, precision/tape and analytic-transfer interfaces remain dependencies. No unconditional multiplication theorem, fresh Lean certification, global optimum or κ=1 is claimed. The older checkpoint's packing ceiling does not apply to this changed factory and port inventory.

Credits and exact source pins are retained for Dugongue (#522/#518/#514/#508/#505), icekylinx (#523), eumemic (#507/#493), DreamingOfClouds and all nested source authors. The new composition, guarded-program projection audit and actual owner allocation were prepared by chafreaky with OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.
